title: The Quarterly Return
body: The quarterly return is due on Friday. It is the same form as last quarter. You fill it in.

choices.outcome: The return is submitted. An automated email confirms receipt.
The return is submitted a day early. An automated email confirms receipt.

title: Is This Satire?
body: Your director leans across the table and lowers her voice. "Between us, this whole system is a bit of a joke, isn't it? A game, almost. Ha!" She looks straight at you for slightly too long, as if you were holding a phone.

choices.text: Laugh along. You get the joke.
choices.outcome: You both laugh. Somewhere, a narrator nods knowingly. The salary is, after all, the punchline. Get it?
She winks. You are fairly sure she winks.
